verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents several programmatic surfaces. The native ClickHouse protocol and HTTP interface cover all SQL and data operations. Its MCP server offers tools to list services, run SQL and read monitoring. CHKit provides typed commands to deploy schema and pipelines as code. Nothing shows UI-level control-plane actions are exposed via an API, such as creating or resizing clusters, managing alert rules or webhook destinations, roles/SSO, or batch-job controls. missing for 10: a documented management/control-plane API, an explicit statement of API–UI parity, API coverage of cluster lifecycle/alerts/access control, independent corroboration.
